about.title: About Company
about.paragraph1: BrandDESIGN has come into existence after many years of experience to make Your brand. It deals with digital large format printing, cutting graphics and gluing, based in Brno.
about.paragraph2: We have long been collaborating with companies in the production of graphics for trade fairs, exhibitions and congresses, not only in the Czech Republic but also around the world. We carry out car stickers, shop windows and the like. Production of 3D log and textile printing. Production of advertising is ensured from design, through production to sticking itself.

printing.title: Printing / Production
printing.description: Technological equipment allows us to meet state-of-the-art trends. Production and digital printing of stickers, printing by cut, full-face printing of transparencies, posters, banners and the like. Production of 3D logos and textile printing.
